": "PEG of 1.64 exceeds Lynch's typical buy threshold of 1.0, despite understandable business and blistering growth (Taiwan GDP +13.69% Q1, ETF +116% YoY). The 61% TSMC concentration ties the fund's fate to AI, and current P/E of 24.67 reflects that optimism without a margin of safety.
